[NADP.4.4.1] If the adapter owns a storage backend
(e.g. a recorder DB, a Redis-backed cache), it registers the cache callbacks
(`ds_engine_cache_callbacks`). The facts plane it might also serve is deferred
([NSTG.3]).
Storage adapters and rule-side adapters are
typically separate; the HA-bridge handles HA
service calls but doesn't own a cache plane.
